scope: Angular web console for the Phase 1-2 capabilities, same-origin SPA hosting by the API, and free hosting guidance. No Phase 3 capability was added.

frontend.mode: standalone components, zoneless change detection, signals
screens: workspace overview with edit and archive
coreBehaviour: antiforgery double-submit contract with one-shot refresh and retry
antiforgery token reset after each authentication transition
typed wire models with numeric enum mapping
RFC 9457 problem rendering on every screen
route guards for authenticated, guest and administrator routes
401 handling that clears the client session view

changes: optional static hosting of wwwroot with SPA route fallback
gitignore entries for generated hosting output, Supabase CLI scratch state and credentials

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: First mutating request after register/login returned 400 Antiforgery validation failed.
defectsFoundAndFixed.cause: ASP.NET Core antiforgery tokens are bound to the identity that requested them; the client cached the anonymous token.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: AuthService resets the cached token after login, registration and logout; the interceptor keeps a refresh-and-retry safety net.

defectsFoundAndFixed.symptom: Console rendered unstyled in a real browser while the build reported success.
defectsFoundAndFixed.cause: Angular critical-CSS inlining injects an inline script that flips a deferred stylesheet; the strict CSP correctly blocked it.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: optimization.styles.inlineCritical disabled in the production build; the CSP keeps inline scripts banned.

freeHostingSummary.recommended: MonsterASP.NET free plan serving the API and the built console from one origin
freeHostingSummary.constraint: Session and antiforgery cookies are SameSite=Strict, so the console must be same-origin with the API
alternatives: Azure App Service F1 (60 CPU-min/day, no AlwaysOn)
Azure Container Apps free monthly grant
Render free web service (idle after ~15 min)
freeHostingSummary.notRecommended: Static-only hosts with a separately hosted API, because cross-site cookies are blocked

knownLimitations: Deployment to a hosting provider was documented but not executed.
PostgreSQL runtime remains unverified in this environment.
Browser verification is a one-shot DevTools script, not a committed component or e2e suite.
Members and scopes are not paginated in the console.
Destructive actions use the browser confirm dialog.
Free-tier provider limits are time-sensitive and must be re-checked.

notes: The Supabase connection file, Supabase CLI scratch workspace and agent-skill scaffolding are gitignored.
No .env, credential or node_modules path was present in the staged commit.
Console documents permit no inline script, no eval and no third-party origin.
The API remains the only authorization boundary; the console hides controls but never decides access.
